leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement performance monitoring by integrating a Core Web Vitals measurement library into a JavaScript application
Configure lazy loading for images and components to reduce initial page load time
Construct a performance budget and apply it to control bundle size and asset optimization
Manipulate the critical rendering path by optimizing CSS delivery and script loading strategies
Initialize and render a virtualized list component to handle large datasets efficiently
Update existing code to implement memoization techniques for expensive function calls
Bind event listeners using debouncing or throttling patterns to improve interaction responsiveness
